# W3Schools

> W3Schools is the world's leading online learning platform for web development, programming languages, and coding education with interactive tutorials, certifications, and video resources.

W3Schools provides comprehensive tutorials and hands-on learning resources for web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL, as well as programming languages like Python, Java, PHP, and C++. The platform offers both free tutorials and professional certification courses through partnerships like Coursera.

## Key Topics

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- SQL
- Python
- Java
- PHP
- Web Development
- Responsive Design
- W3.CSS Framework
- Bootstrap
- React
- Full-Stack Development
- Online Tutorials
- Certification Courses

## Core Learning Platform

- [W3Schools Homepage](https://www.w3schools.com): Main entry point offering tutorials in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL and comprehensive web development learning paths
- [W3Schools Coursera Certification](https://coursera.w3schools.com/): Professional certification platform for HTML, CSS, JavaScript and web development with credential programs

## Learning Resources & Tutorials

- [Video Tutorials Index](https://www.w3schools.com/videos/index.php): Comprehensive video tutorial collection covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL and core web development topics

## Frontend Frameworks & Libraries

- [W3.CSS Framework](https://www.w3schools.com/w3css/default.asp): Lightweight responsive design framework documentation and tutorial for modern front-end development
